description: Needs a free TronRelic account: calling it makes your app ask the user to sign in, then the call runs. Search the published site pages for a text, most recently changed first, as short summaries without the body. The query is matched case-insensitively as a literal substring of each page's title, slug, description, keywords, and body. It is not a boolean or fuzzy search, so use a distinctive word or short phrase such as "energy rental", not a whole question. Use to find pages about a topic; use pages-list to browse everything. Parameters: query (required, 1 to 100 characters); page (optional, 1-based, default 1); limit (optional, default 20, at most 50). Returns query, total (every match), page, limit, hasMore, and pages[] of { id, slug, title, description, keywords, updatedAt, excerpt }. No matches returns an empty list, not an error. Pass an id or slug to pages-get to read a page in full. Pages are TronRelic's admin-written site pages served at paths such as /about. A site page is standing reference content kept current at a fixed address, such as a guide, explainer, policy, or documentation. Dated writing about something that happened, such as news, a market update, or a time-bound analysis, is a blog post, not a page; use the blog tools for those when they are available. These tools return only published pages exactly as visitors see them; drafts and edits waiting for review are never returned. Read-only; never changes a page.

limit.description: Pages per call. Default 20, at most 50.

query.description: Text to find (1 to 100 characters), matched case-insensitively as a literal substring.

name: pages-search
title: Search site pages
